key_passage.text: A set of parallel straws allow parallel light rays to pass from the scene to the projection plane, but extinguish rays passing from all other directions. The straw camera doesn't invert the image as the pinhole camera does and objects do not get smaller as they move away from the camera. The image projection is orthographic, with a unity scale factor; the object sizes on the projection plane are the same as those of the objects in the world.
